"We tested a correction technique
on a standard test circuit, on
real quantum hardware, at two
sizes. It cut wrong measurements
by about two-thirds at the
smaller size, less at the larger
one -- consistent with correction
getting harder as circuits grow.
We only tested two sizes on one
device."
